items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee narrates events involving Fats Waller and Art Tatum ('Fats was there at the time', 'Fats, he just took Art by the arm') but does not describe a personal interaction or relationship with Fats Waller himself.

ctx.x: She was going to take him to Europe to play for her. He came in the rhythm club and sat down and was blind. And Fats was there at the time and Fats heard him and he went and got every piano kind of player that he thought he could find. He went and got the Lion. He got Jimmy -- James P. Johnson, all the piano players that he could find to come and hear. This was a phenomenon to him. It was Art Tatum.
